about: The Scraper, Super Scraper and Ace of Spades at work on a Barnacle, an Ice Nubbin, a Dirt Pile and Peat (lane refsart, register G646; js/node-tools.js): each SWF's tool_animation scene (root timeline; scraper.swf 3-53, super_scraper.swf 2-52, ace_of_spades.swf 4-56) at 3x, rendered from a copy with a padded stage (padStage), as hand-tools.json does for the tools drawn beside the avatar (the Shovel's sheet is there). The 1x sheets are Tiny Speck's OGA recordings packed by tools/packed-sheets/build.py (a swing's last frame is its first picture again, kept once): frameList gives each packed cell's SWF frame. Run: node tools/vector-sprites/build.mjs --manifest tools/vector-sprites/node-tools.json
